title: ai-rulez exposure leakage
description: Output of `ai-rulez exposure leakage --format json`: the area terms in the text a Claude Code session sees at its start (AR9W0, AR9W1), with their acceptance by [[lint.accept]], the start-of-session artifacts whose text could not be read, and the acceptances of those rules that accepted nothing (AR9I0). See docs/exposure.md.

root.description: The absolute repository root inspected (--root), slash separated.

plugins.description: The plugin mode of the inventory.

areas_file.description: The areas file the map was read from, relative to the root and slash separated (absolute when it lies outside the root); empty for the inline [exposure] form.

artifacts_checked.description: The start-of-session artifacts, an artifact of unknown phase and an unchecked one included.

findings.description: By artifact in inventory order: a text's violations by line (within a line by term, then area map order), then a listing's warnings by term.

severity.description: violation: an error finding, which fails the command; warning: a finding below error; accepted: a finding a [[lint.accept]] entry accepts.

area.description: The area the term names; for AR9W1, every area that uses the ambiguous word, sorted and joined by "/".

term.description: The term or ambiguous word, lowercase as the area map holds it.

name.description: The qualified name of the artifact (plugin:skill for a plugin skill).

path.description: The file, relative to the root and slash separated.

scope.description: The directory that owns the artifact; "." for the root.

line.description: The file line of a CLAUDE.md or rule line; 1 for a listing line, a server or plugin name, and every AR9W1 finding.

excerpt.description: The line (for AR9W1, the listing), whitespace squashed, cut to 140 characters.

reason.description: The reason of the [[lint.accept]] entry of an accepted finding, else empty.

unchecked.description: The start-of-session artifacts kept unread (over the read limit, or a symlink to outside the root), in inventory order: they load in every session, but no leak in them can be found. They are not findings and do not change the exit code.

path.description: The file, relative to the root and slash separated.

name.description: The qualified name of the artifact.

reason.description: Why the file was not read.

stale_acceptances.description: The AR9I0 messages of the [[lint.accept]] entries for AR9W0 or AR9W1 that accepted no finding.
